claims: Micron Technology (MU) reported Q2 2026 results on March 18, 2026.
Micron Technology issued Q3 guidance projecting $33.5 billion in revenue.
Micron Technology issued Q3 guidance of $19.15 EPS.
Micron Technology's stock gained over 355% over the past year.
Micron Technology approved a 30% increase in the quarterly dividend.
CEO Sanjay Mehrotra stated memory has become a strategic asset for customers
